messages:
nina: Flagging a suspicious pattern: multiple refunds issued to the same card ending 3333 across three accounts (acct_2201, acct_2202, acct_2203) on 2026-04-12. Combined $5,760. One cardholder filed a chargeback for $1,920. Need evidence + recommended action.
billing-bot: Chargeback created 4307210 for txn `T20260412-bc3`  reason: cardholder_dispute  dispute window ends 2026-06-10.
paul: quick correlates: refunds initiated via vendor integrator `fast-refund` (integration id: fr-12). API key used: fr_key_live_55. Refund requests show short intervals (seconds) between each call. Example: POST /v1/refunds {"charge":"T20260412-01","amount":640} 
henry: origin IPs: 45.77.55.10, 45.77.55.11 (ASN: AS20473)  geo: Netherlands. Merchant profiles are US-based.
paul: webhook delivery returns 200 for all. Partner claims they rotated keys on 2026-04-11, but logs show the older key used on 04-12.
nina: action proposals: 1) suspend fr-12 integration & revoke key, 2) upload unified evidence packet, 3) notify Legal & CS to pause outreach, 4) ask partner for signed audit trail. Thoughts?
henry: +1 suspend. Also suggest we check for related console logins and any new API keys created in our system referencing fr-12.
security-oncall: Opening security ticket SEC-20260412-07 to request partner proof of rotation and origin headers. Recommend immediate key rotation and forensic logs from partner.
paul: placed provisional hold HLD-20260412-07 at 2026-04-12T10:42Z. Evidence packet uploaded: https://redwood.internal/evidence/CB4307210 (finance, disputes).
nina: thanks. Legal please advise on contest vs accept once partner provides logs.
